systems.tiers: launched 2024-03-28 in the commune of Golfe 3, pilot phase: two public health facilities, CMS Doumasséssé and CHU Campus, connected to the commune's civil status agents, who receive birth and death declarations in real time

note: The article describes health centres and residents sending birth and death declarations online to the commune's civil status agents; it does not say that the agents make the civil status record digitally, so the system is notification and gives no fact.
